record.question: Which of the following devices has the 'negative resistance' characteristic?
record.explanation: The Gunn diode shows a negative differential resistance region in its bulk V-I characteristic, which is the standard textbook answer. Reflex klystron also exhibits negative conductance, so the key is somewhat open to dispute.
